response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with a strong general software background, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated experience with Linux kernel modification, embedded firmware, LAN switches, or the listed security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal), and his C experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint years ago. His career trajectory centers on web, TypeScript/Node.js, and DLang rather than embedded systems.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering experience across many stacks and companies
Some low-level/systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement (native-level)
No embedded firmware, LAN-switch, Linux kernel, or networking-security (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF) experience
Minimal recent C/UNIX systems programming; career focus is web and application development
